# Fatline

> Your own Farcaster (Snapchain) or Hypersnap read node and your own client, in a few commands; and a launchpad where each node gets a coin whose trading fees pay for it. Open source, MIT.

## Set up
- [Agent skill: "Help me mint one of the 777 Fatlines" (the mint is not open yet) and set up a Fatline step by step](https://fatline.ink/skill.md): rules (money needs the person's yes, never handle seed phrases or tokens) and every command.
- [Installer](https://fatline.ink/install.sh): `curl -fsSL https://fatline.ink/install.sh | sh` downloads Fatline and starts the guided `fatline setup`.
- [Docs](https://fatline.ink/docs/index.md): one Markdown file: the story, minting, running a node.
- [Tutorial](https://fatline.ink/docs/tutorial.html): every step, English, Spanish, Chinese.

- [Manifesto](https://fatline.ink/manifesto.html): the 777, how they are born, and what is true today.

## Source
- [Repository](https://github.com/jpfraneto/fatline): README has what is tested and what is not.
- [The Fatline protocol](https://github.com/jpfraneto/fatline/blob/main/research/FATLINE-PROTOCOL.md)
- [The 777 Fatliners](https://github.com/jpfraneto/fatline/tree/main/fatliners)
